audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart is a blanket 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet carry a real curve (Qiyana 1-4 and first item, Diana at 6 and 2+ items).
audit.why: Grounded: Diana pre-6 depends on landing Crescent Strike for Lunar Rush resets; her 6 spike (Moonfall + doubled Pale Cascade) beats Qiyana's all-in; two items she outscales.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content win[]; whys rewritten to match. Packet flags the chart as generous to Qiyana at 47.37% WR — recorded, not acted on, since prose and both layers agree.

audit.why: Spikes: Qiyana 1-4, Diana 5-6, Qiyana first item, Diana late — recorded and internally consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content claims Diana is 'immobile until 6' / 'no gap-closer beyond a single R' and calls an 'E-pull' — her E is Lunar Rush, a dash on 22/20/18/16/14s that resets off Moonlight; the pull is Moonfall (R). Cooldowns field had no digits.
audit.why: Kit: Q Crescent Strike 8-6s applies Moonlight; E Lunar Rush no-cooldown onto marked targets; W Pale Cascade shield 15-9s; R Moonfall 100/90/80 pulls.
audit.corrected: Mobility claims rewritten around the Q-mark -> E-reset dependency; E-pull renamed; digits added.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Terrashape (element swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Diana Crescent Strike (Q, 8s at rank 1, 6s max): matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset Lunar Rush; sidestep the arc and her E is a 22s dash with no follow-up. - Pale Cascade runs 15-9s; trade in its downtime. - Budget Terrashape for emergencies, the R for opportunities.

edits.before: Level 3 W-E-Q dives her before she has any gap-closer.
edits.after: Level 3 W-E-Q dives her on her 22s Lunar Rush cooldown.

edits.before: You own levels 1-4: pre-6 Diana has no gap-closer beyond a single R and her Crescent Strike (Q) is easy to sidestep. W-E-Q trade whenever her Q is on cooldown and deny her the passive third-hit burst. But at level 5 her shield (Pale Cascade W) plus Q poke lets her win the return trade, so back off once she has both points there.
edits.after: You own levels 1-4: Diana's dash, Lunar Rush (E), runs a 22s cooldown unless she lands Crescent Strike's Moonlight mark first — sidestep the arc and she has no way in. W-E-Q trade whenever her Q is down and deny the passive third-hit burst. At level 5 her Pale Cascade (W) shield plus Q poke wins the return trade, so back off then.

edits.before: This is her spike, not yours. Diana at 6 with Moonfall (R) reels you in, and her E-pull plus Pale Cascade shield make her all-in stronger than yours in a straight melee brawl. Don't stand next to her when her R is up; bait it or fight only when she has used her mobility on the wave.
edits.after: This is her spike, not yours. Diana at 6 with Moonfall (R) reels you in, and Lunar Rush resets off Moonlight plus the Pale Cascade shield make her all-in stronger than yours in a straight melee brawl. Don't stand next to her when R is up; bait it or fight only when her dash is spent on the wave.

edits.before: You control levels 1-4. Diana is immobile until 6, her Crescent Strike is a slow, dodgeable arc, and her passive burst needs three hits you can interrupt. Trade element-Q on her Q cooldowns and shove for camo roams; she cannot punish a disciplined walk-up this early.
edits.after: You control levels 1-4. Diana's only way in is Lunar Rush off a Moonlight mark, her Crescent Strike is a slow, dodgeable arc, and her passive burst needs three hits. Trade element-Q on her Q cooldowns and shove for camo roams; she cannot punish a disciplined walk-up this early.
